deeper.title: What the price assumes
deeper.text: The price assumes about 6% a year growth in free cash flow for 10 years, then 3% (discount rate 9.9% = 10-year Treasury 4.9% + 5%; base: last 12 months of free cash flow). For comparison, sales grew 7% last year; 5%/yr over 3 years — roughly in line with its recent growth.

deeper.title: Return on capital
deeper.text: Not meaningful (the company holds more cash than its debt plus equity, or data is missing); return on shareholders' equity 31% (3 years ago 30%).

deeper.title: Signed future revenue
deeper.text: Signed but not yet delivered (remaining performance obligations): $69.0B, up 8% from a year ago — about 1.0× the last 12 months of sales; customer prepayments not yet earned (deferred revenue): $19.5B, up 10% from a year ago.

deeper.title: Earnings-quality red flags
flags: Inventory up 39% vs quarterly sales up 5% (days of inventory 18 → 24). Products may be building up unsold — a warning sign in chip cycles.

deeper.text: Returned $6.3B to shareholders over the last 12 months ($0M buybacks + $6.3B dividends) = 2.7% of the company's market value. Share count up 0.5% from a year ago (about flat).

deeper.title: Analyst estimates
